# Omitted Git LFS files

These 171 files are stored upstream in Git LFS (~586 MB, mostly test fixture videos and images). They were left out of this snapshot: GitHub rejects LFS pointers without their objects, and uploading them would exceed the free LFS quota. Get them from https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes with `git lfs pull` if needed.
